newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold ends slightly up at day's high in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Gold ends slightly up at day's high in Hong Kong.

text.p: Gold closed slightly firmer at its day's high in Hong Kong on Friday on mild short-covering following gains in New York overnight, but dealers said trading was quiet. Bullion ended at US$342.40/90 an ounce against New York's US$342.30/80 close on Thursday and Hong Kong's previous finish of US$341.30/80.

"Market players were shortcovering, believing that gold had seen its lowest point and was recovering," said a dealer at a local investment house. "But the market retained its bearish mantle and gold's range is likely to stay within US$340-345."
Local gold ended HK$6 higher at HK$3,168 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -8.00 from its previous fix at -6.00.
